mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices (author_id, title, content, is_pinned) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{pinned})
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.author_id, n.title, n.content, n.is_pinned AS pinned, n.view_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM notices n LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = n.author_id WHERE n.id = #{id}

SELECT n.id, n.author_id, n.title, n.content, n.is_pinned AS pinned, n.view_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM notices n LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = n.author_id ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
